name: Convertible JPY Token
oneLiner: CJPY is Yamato's decentralized Japanese yen stablecoin, minted from overcollateralized ETH pledges via Liquity-v1-style permissionless CDPs.
collateral: ETH only; 130% minimum collateralization ratio at issuance (110% MCR for liquidation); one-time borrowing fee with no accrued interest
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized ETH CDPs (pledges) with game-theory peg maintenance: (1) hard floor via on-chain redemption of 1 CJPY for 1 JPY worth of ETH from the riskiest pledge; (2) subrogation mechanism uses accumulated protocol fees to automatically repay positions below 100% health rate; (3) non-forced liquidation where any user can redeem debt positions below 130% using market-purchased CJPY

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: No direct CJPY blacklist or transfer freeze was confirmed, but Yamato's CurrencyOS/Yamato routing is governance-settable and includes protocol burn and pause paths. Treat as possible mutable holder-facing protocol control.

mintAuthority.summary: CJPY is minted permissionlessly from Yamato's Liquity-v1-style ETH pledges (130% MCR, one-time fee, no interest); the DeFiGeek Community / Yamato DAO (YMT/veYMT) leads versioned, upgradeable contracts and parameter governance.

controls.label: Yamato pledge contract (ETH CDP mint)
controls.capDescription: Mint bounded by the 130% minimum collateralization ratio on ETH pledges, with redemption-based peg defense.
controls.evidence: Users mint CJPY by overcollateralizing ETH at a 130% MCR via the Yamato pledge contract; redemption of the riskiest pledge enforces the hard floor.

controls.label: Yamato DAO (YMT/veYMT) governance and upgrade authority
controls.evidence: Unlike immutable Liquity v1, Yamato is upgradeable and DAO-governed via YMT/veYMT, with the development team leading version upgrades and parameter changes; no holder-balance freeze on CJPY.

review.evidence: Yamato docs and DeFiGeek materials describe a Liquity-v1-style permissionless ETH CDP minting CJPY, but with an upgradeable, DAO-governed (YMT/veYMT) architecture rather than Liquity v1's immutability, so immutable classification is not asserted.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Mechanism and upgradeable DAO governance confirmed from Yamato docs; exact upgrade-admin/proxy owner and governance threshold not independently read on-chain.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the Yamato upgrade admin/proxy owner and the YMT/veYMT governance execution path on-chain.
